action: Fix three bugs in TaskQueue: (1) push() uses 'priority > t[priority]' which should be 'priority < t[priority]' — currently inserts high-urgency tasks at the wrong end. (2) pop() calls self._tasks.pop() which removes the last element, should be self._tasks.pop(0) to remove the first. (3) drain() returns a copy but never clears self._tasks — add self._tasks.clear() after building result.
